status: User-selected controller direction; reference defaults, not applied to native Dusk
controller: V1 exponential band controller with coverage direction
governance: Market-specific authorized replacement, accruing old interval before switching; preserve ongoing rates
reference_note: Default translation only; never recalculate band from live utilization
